tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Use when the user has a supplier_id or slug and needs the full public profile: location, capabilities, tolerances, materials, batch range, certifications, logo, equipment types (aggregated), and up to 20 recent works with image URLs. Contact email and phone are never returned. Use search_suppliers f

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Use after search_works or when the user supplies a work_id. Returns the canonical work page URL and public supplier summary. No buyer, contact, price or inquiry data is included.

tools.name: list_supplier_capability_rows
tools.description: Use when the user needs valid capability/process ids, category names, tiers or required equipment specs before searching suppliers or works. This is a curated L0 dictionary from grid_capabilities.csv and equipment_types.csv; it is not a supplier list.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Use when the user asks which Chinese factories can make a part, which suppliers offer a process (CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, die casting, etc.), or wants suppliers filtered by region, certification or material. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_supplier, get_work, search_suppliers, search_works · Private data: get_supplier, get_work · Public sink: get_supplier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_supplier, get_work, search_suppliers, search_works · Private data: get_supplier, get_work · Public sink: get_supplier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
